shared_elements: small repeated stroke marks / rows of short lines
schematic low-relief linear motifs on a rough surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, outline-style linear motifs, and A's carved crescent bands and rows of short strokes echo in a very loose way B's boat hull with its palisade of crew-strokes, but this is generic linear schematism rather than a shared motif. A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms, a large disc on the back and belt-like bands, while B depicts a manned boat with upturned animal-head prows, a quadruped and free-floating strokes — no shared subject or relationship.
